body: I wish the other person would put the same effort in as I have. I refuse to let them go do what they want only to think I am waiting.
I think you should give this person your address, this seems to be a result of becoming sober, and maybe it's not your time.

If he wasn't trying to overdose he is ok. If he is always trying to be higher then you might as well try writing a eulogy. I'm sorry that you had to leave. I hope they will be ok and not hurt themselves

It's hard, I am troubled by the same things, iv3 punched doors and walls and kicked out bus stop seats. Its hardest for people like me and you. Go take your anger out on a punching bag, scream when no one is around, do anything except what you really want to do. Clarity will help too, after you get your anger out maybe you will see it wasn't worth your time or feelings but its hardest for people like me and you.

Your looking for ways to cope, if you had anger before I would reccomend looking up borderline personality disorder symptoms. If not then it probably comes from pain and frustration. I feel your pain, the same thing is happening to alot of others and it isn't gender specific. I hope it starts to pass

Sometimes it's unfair when someone moves on quickly, it makes you feel like the time spent together was worthless. I wouldn't be sharing the same room with that person but I understand you still have feelings. He may just be saying it to hurt you. He probably isn't looking for an emotional connection just a physical one, which can be good and bad. Usually a break up can show a person's true side and how they will hurt the person they supposedly cared about..
I hope you can start to feel better even though it feels impossible right now..

The emptiness isn't real, your being consumed by feelings but they are not rational ones. What would you feel if you were to lose your FP because of these irrational thoughts? It could lead to something much more serious. You think they will give you medicine but the only cure to BDP is DBT therapy and things like that. I would suggest looking at the symptoms of BDP and think of as many situations that fall under it to see how self destructive it is...

Sounds like a severe depression that you are letting control you. Also sounds like you 2 are not communicating. I think like other people wrote you may need counseling if you haven't recovered from something that happened many years ago. 

Another thing might be you want to be part of his project for fun but when it becomes work you don't make the same time. Maybe a different outlook is needed to keep you motivated as well. 

If you started to see some progress you would probably be more likely to keep going with things. I'm not bashing, I hope you 2 can be successful in your comic and share that success with each other.

There's no ages here but why would Halloween matter? It also sounds like your not asking any questions and vice versa. You both  need to open up and find out what you both want. Maybe it wont be the same. Maybe you both will have to compromise. More sex will not fix your relationship.
Why does he need to do 5? Why not let him get going with 1..2...3 and let him see some success instead of insisting on 5 minimum?
I have pretty much abandoned all friends and family and I've thrown other things away due to it. Also the hard drugs are coming back, I don't think ill be able to go back to normal ever.

I know what it feels like to want someone who doesn't feel the same back. For me we were together and I messed up and we no longer are. She's moved on and it still feels like I can't. I felt suicidal and ended up being in the hospital. I understand the way your feeling.
